source: Two user-provided RAR volumes; supplied as Millennium Dawn map/history files
note: No full upstream mod was imported. Top-level states/ duplicates history/states/ and was ignored.

degenerate_provinces.note: Provinces drawn with 1-7 pixels collapse in the engine's downsampled province masks and crash it with C0000094 INT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO in the province-graphics chain.

geometry.coordinate_system: x = bitmap column; z = height - 1 - bitmap row (integer sampling)
